rounds.title: Text input baseline
rounds.note: The SDK text input (et-input inside et-form-field), first drawing, drawn by textInput() from @ethlete/components/design/input, which wraps formField() and input() from the form-field mock with the real markup and CSS: et-label with the required marker, the control frame with prefix and suffix affixes, et-description, the support row with hint and error; the box appearance, transparent fill, static label, md size; the brand theme, danger as the error theme. Hover is forced on the control frame, focus as data-focused plus focus-visible on the native input. Fixtures are fictional: Email, lena.hoffmann@example.com, placeholder name@example.com, hint We only use it to sign you in., description Your team sees this address on your profile., required with value lena.hoffmann@ and error Enter a valid email address.; API key with the lock and check icons; Website with https:// and .de text affixes; search, password, end-aligned amount with EUR, a mixed bulk-edit value, and an unlabelled field. Framed as a page with 16px padding at 320, 360 and 640. Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2 at 360, brand mint, a: rest frame (surface border) vs page 1.26 / 1.73, the only edge of an empty field; hover frame (surface-interaction-hover) 10.37 / 13.07; focus frame (primary) 1.33 / 13.50; error frame (danger at 50 %) 2.30 / 1.72, error hover (danger ink) 6.47 / 6.48; placeholder (46 % of the text colour) 3.00 / 4.48; required marker (brand primary) 1.33 / 13.50; readonly frame and text identical to filled (1.26 / 1.73, 17.93 / 17.18). Decided rules that arise: Q88 (focus in ink: the focus frame takes ink, the invalid one the danger ink) and Q99a (a mint mark on light takes ink: the required marker light-dark(ink, primary)). Lib bugs apart: (L1) et-description had no inline start padding: it started at the frame edge, 13px left of the label, the value and the hint (Storybook Description at 360: description x 42, label, input and hint x 55); b and c drew it aligned. Fixed in the lib (et-description takes the control inline padding plus the border width): its text starts at x 55 with the label, value and hint, in every variant. (L2) type search showed the Chromium native cancel button (an unthemed UA glyph) on focus, nothing in the lib styled it (shot in Storybook Input Default with type search, focused; a forced focus in a sketch does not draw it). Fixed in the lib (appearance: none on the cancel button): a focused search input with a value shows no UA glyph. Design: (1) WCAG 1.4.11: the rest frame 1.26 / 1.73 and the error frame 2.30 / 1.72 are under 3:1; c answers both. (2) Placeholder 3.00 in light, under 4.5:1; c draws it at 60 %, 4.67 / 6.77. (3) Readonly looks exactly like an editable filled field and gets neither hover nor focus; c proposes a dashed frame (my proposal, not a decided rule). (4) Hover (10.37 / 13.07) outshines the focus frame (5.48 / 13.50) in b and c, as on the otp input; in c the rest frame 4.74 sits close to the focus 5.48 in light, told apart by hue only. (5) A text prefix sits a full affix gap from the value (https://  example.com), so a URL prefix reads as a separate word. (6) The error marker 3.71 in dark, exempted as in checkbox r1. Later rounds, left out here: underline appearance, filled fill, the floating and inline label modes, sm and lg sizes, data-warning, the counter, the busy spinner, browser autofill colours, RTL and the support animation.
rounds.lost: r1 measured the lib as is (a), the decided rules Q88 and Q99a (b) and four proposals (c). Tom turned the findings into rules Q108-Q113 (plans/ethlete-studio/backlog-parallel.md, 23937188b): 3:1 frames also in error, a 4.5:1 placeholder, a non-colour readonly signal, a 2px focus frame that is the strongest state, a 4px text prefix gap and a 4.5:1 required marker. r2 draws them; no r1 variant is picked.

rounds.title: Input design rules
rounds.note: Input design rules Q108-Q113 (plans/ethlete-studio/backlog-parallel.md, 23937188b), drawn on c with Q99a. New states: focus-hover, invalid-focus-hover, readonly-hover, text-prefix (€). Numbers (light / dark) from shot pixels at scale 2 at 360, brand mint: rest frame 4.74 / 6.94; hover 6.69 / 8.94; focus d theme ink 5.48 / 13.50, e surface text 17.93 / 17.18; error frame 4.83 / 3.71, error hover and focus danger ink 6.47 / 6.48; placeholder 4.67 / 6.77 vs value 17.93 / 17.18; required marker brand ink 5.48 / 13.50, in error danger ink 6.47 / 6.48 (was 3.71 in dark); error text already danger ink 6.47 / 6.48. Open choices: focus colour (d theme ink vs e surface text), readonly signal (d dashed frame vs f lock icon). Open point: a focused readonly field shows no focus frame in the lib (readonly is excluded from the focus rule), so a keyboard user sees no focus there; Q111 says focus is always the strongest state.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light the focus frame and the required marker are mint 1.33 vs page (dark 13.50); rest frame 1.26 / 1.73 and error frame 2.30 / 1.72, both under 3:1; placeholder 3.00 / 4.48; readonly identical to filled; et-description started 13px left of the label and hint (L1, now fixed).

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88 and Q99a, decided rules only, plus the L1 fix drawn. The focus frame in ink: light 5.48 vs page (was 1.33), dark the ink is the mint, 13.50 as today; the invalid one in the danger ink, 6.47 / 6.48. The required marker light-dark(ink, primary), light 5.48 (was 1.33). et-description takes the control inline padding plus the border width, so it lines up with the label, value and hint. Rest, error, placeholder and readonly unchanged. Picked because it applies only decided rules and a lib bug fix, so the text input reads like the otp input.

c.note: b plus four proposals, not decided rules: the rest frame in surface-interaction, 4.74 / 6.94 vs page (was 1.26 / 1.73); the error frame in the full danger primary, 4.83 / 3.71 (was 2.30 / 1.72), its hover and focus keep the danger ink 6.47 / 6.48; the placeholder at 60 % of the text colour, 4.67 / 6.77 (was 3.00 / 4.48); a dashed readonly frame so readonly no longer looks editable. In light the rest frame 4.74 sits close to the focus ink 5.48, told apart by hue only.

d.note: Pick. Rules Q108-Q113. Rest frame surface-interaction 4.74 / 6.94 vs page (Q108); hover a small step, 75 % interaction + 25 % text colour, 6.69 / 8.94, unfocused fields only; error frame full danger 4.83 / 3.71, error hover danger ink 6.47 / 6.48; placeholder 60 % of the text colour 4.67 / 6.77, value 17.93 / 17.18 (Q109); focus a 2px frame (1px border + 1px inset shadow, no layout shift, no halo), unchanged on hover (Q111); error focus 2px danger ink 6.47 / 6.48; a text prefix (€, https://) sits 4px from the value, an icon prefix keeps the 8px affix gap (Q112); required marker in the theme ink, brand 5.48 / 13.50, in error the danger ink 6.47 / 6.48 instead of the danger primary 3.71 in dark (Q113), so the contrast exception is gone. Focus frame in the theme ink, 5.48 / 13.50. Readonly: dashed frame at the rest tone (4.74 / 6.94), no hover. Cost: in light the hover frame (6.69) out-contrasts the focus ink (5.48); focus wins on width and hue only.

e.note: d with the focus frame in the surface text colour (black / white), 17.93 / 17.18: focus is the strongest by contrast too, not only by width. Cost: loses the brand hue on focus; error focus stays danger ink.

f.note: d with readonly as a solid rest frame plus a lock icon in the suffix (muted affix at 78 %, about 4.6 / 5.3) instead of the dashed frame. Cost: the lock already means secret on the API key field, and it takes a suffix slot.

g.note: Aligned variant Q140-Q144 for Tom's merge. e plus Q141-Q143 and the Q139 error hover. Q140: focus frame in the surface text colour, 2px, 17.93 / 17.18. Q141: readonly is a dashed frame at the rest tone, no lock icon, no hover. Q142: readonly focus is a 2px dashed frame in the Q140 focus colour (outline 2px dashed, offset -2px, over a transparent border, no layout shift); the lib draws none today. Q143: rest frame surface-interaction 4.74 / 6.94. Q139: error hover in the error theme's active ink tone (--et-color-primary-ink-active chain), as the lib since 798968a69. Hover step, full danger error frame, 60 % placeholder, 4px text prefix gap and required marker (theme ink, danger ink in error) as e. Frame vs page (light / dark), shot pixels at scale 2 at 360: rest 4.74 / 6.94; hover 6.69 / 8.94; focus 17.93 / 17.18; readonly 4.74 / 6.94; readonly focus 17.93 / 17.18; error 4.83 / 3.71; error hover 10.02 / 4.76.
